In detail

West Yorkshire Police recorded 640 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 6.8 per 1,000 residents, the 24th highest rate of Leeds's 33 wards. The daytime score here is driven by burglary (19), shoplifting (14), vehicle crime (13); the evening/night score by violent crime (75), anti social behaviour (21), public order (19). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Headingley & Hyde Park safe?

Wandroz currently rates Headingley & Hyde Park in Leeds as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Leeds during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Leeds at night. This rating is derived from West Yorkshire Police street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Headingley & Hyde Park safe at night?

At night, Headingley & Hyde Park is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Leeds. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Headingley & Hyde Park a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Headingley & Hyde Park's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Leeds) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
